title: Phronix：面向智能体的能力中心学习范式
summary: Phronix提出以能力为中心的学习范式，通过预测-验证-纠正循环，让智能体从自身执行中获取、验证并精炼可复用能力。学习到的能力首次尝试即解决重复任务的成功率达93-95%，每任务自动生成7.6-30.8项持久能力，热启动token消耗仅为基线的1/4，并将廉价模型在SWE-bench上的解决率从约28%提升至87-91%。
summary_en: Phronix introduces a capability-centric learning paradigm where agent harnesses acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions via a predictor-validator-corrector loop. Learned capabilities solve recurring tasks on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases, generate 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task, cut warm-start token usage to a quarter of baseline, and lift cheaper models' SWE-bench solve rates from ~28% to 87-91%.
